english.title: Permit non motor vehicle to be left in dangerous position
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), permitted

(A)_[the vehicle]_
(B)_[a trailer drawn by it]_

to remain at rest on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), in such

(C)_[a position]_
(D)_[condition]_
(E)_[circumstances]_

as to involve a danger of injury to other persons using the road
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
